flow: ENS in the game: name a world right after Create (a Chinese name gets a chosen label), launch it from the app, the HUD's name chip, the chapter-clear offer that records the run with its door, remix → name under the parent → launch in the parent's token, a friend walking onto the continent by the save's ENS name, and the old ENS paths gone

env.station: bun run relay:dev (wrangler dev on 8790, the station's own key 0xB62C…Fd3D, this build's src/relay with the launch rule)
env.app A: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$TMPDIR/ud-ens-a (fresh) UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_RELAY=http://127.0.0.1:8790 UNWRITTEN_SIGN_BROWSER=none bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9336 (restarted three times on the same userData to load main-side fixes; see result.md)
env.app B: AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$TMPDIR/ud-ens-b (fresh) UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_RELAY= UNWRITTEN_SIGN_BROWSER=none bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9337 (no passkey, no station)
env.signaling: PORT=4464 node node_modules/y-webrtc/bin/server.js; both apps: localStorage unwritten.signaling = ws://127.0.0.1:4464
env.browser: '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=9350 --user-data-dir=<fresh>; each '[market] sign page' URL from app A's log opened with PUT /json/new?<url>
env.passkey: CDP WebAuthn virtual authenticator with the credential exported in milestone-lineage-relay (account 0xfBaB…8537), standing in for Touch ID

model: openai gpt-5.4-mini (Create's cards, story and origin; the chapter; witnessing). Naming, launching and joining ask no model.

every signature (page side, CDP_PORT=935.clickText: Approve with Touch ID  (the link page: Use my existing passkey)

A1 link the passkey (app A, CDP_PORT=933.clickText: 用 Touch ID（在瀏覽器開啟）

A1 link the passkey (app A, CDP_PORT=933: … link page: Use my existing passkey …

A2 Create 霧之港 → name → launch.type: 霧氣終年不散的港口小鎮，燈塔守著回不了家的船。

A3 clear chapter 1 of 霧之港 (the gamepad r.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<360;i++){const c=await window.__e2e.chapter(); if(c&&c.written){return {ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, npcs: c.npcs?.map(n=>n.name), treasures: c.treasures?.length, monsters: c.monsters};} const card=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(e=>/撰寫下一章|寫作失敗|失敗/.test(e.innerText) && e.innerText.length<300); if(card && /失敗|錯誤|error/i.test(card.innerText)) return {failed: card.innerText}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));} return 'not written after 180 s'})()

repeat.until: (async()=>{const s=await window.__e2e.state(); const t=await window.__e2e.nextTodo(); return !t || !s.nearby || s.nearby.id!==t.id})()

A4 remix aether-land from the Remix butt: (1.0.0 failed validation before the fix; after it: set 版本 1.0.1, 驗證並預覽, 發布)

B1 walk in by name (app B, CDP_PORT=9337.eval: (async()=>{const seen=[];let last='';const t=Date.now();for(let i=0;i<300;i++){const m=(document.body.innerText.match(/大陸 [A-Z0-9]{6}[^\n]*|正在查[^\n]*/)||[''])[0];if(m&&m!==last){seen.push((Date.now()-t)+' ms '+m);last=m;}if(/1 位夥伴/.test(m))return JSON.stringify(seen);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return JSON.stringify(seen)})()

(async()=>{const m=await import('/net/doorByName.ts');const out={};for(const n of ['first-light.aether-land.unmapped.eth','nobody-here-7x.unmapped.eth','misty-harbor.unmapped.eth','my-save.misty-harbor.unmapped.eth']){const r=await m.resolveDoor(n);out[n]=r.ok?r.value:r.error.code}return JSON.stringify(out)})()

B2 the old paths.shell: bun run ens:setup   # → Script not found

A6 clear chapter 2, then move the name (: (the chapter loop of A3 with until = two episodes cleared)
